name: Content Type 2 Code
definition: Identification of the type of a Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS) data structure.

DATA.name: Plain Data
DATA.definition: Generic, non cryptographic, or unqualified data content - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: id-data).

EVLP.name: Enveloped Data
EVLP.definition: Encrypted data, with encryption key - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: id-envelopedData).

AUTH.name: Authenticated Data
AUTH.definition: MAC (Message Authentication Code), with encryption key - (ASN.1 Object Identifier: id-ct-authData).
